screen.keybind_priority.title: Keybind Priority: %s
screen.keybind_priority.heading: Keybind Priority
screen.keybind_priority.hint: %s bindings on this key · the top one comes first
screen.keybind_priority.mode.tooltip:
All bindings: every binding on this key reacts, like without this mod.
Top binding only: just the highest binding that can react right now.
screen.keybind_priority.empty: Nothing is bound to this key.
screen.keybind_priority.on.tooltip: Click to silence this binding on this key. Its keybind stays.
screen.keybind_priority.off.tooltip: Silenced on this key. Click to turn it back on.
screen.keybind_priority.item.title: Item condition
screen.keybind_priority.item.none: No item condition. Click to make this binding depend on the held item.
screen.keybind_priority.item.mode.explai: This binding only reacts while you hold a matching item. Otherwise the next one in the list takes over.
While you hold a matching item, this binding moves to the top. Without one, the normal order applies.
screen.keybind_priority.item.mode.needs_: Only has an effect in mode "top binding only".
screen.keybind_priority.item.empty_filte: Type an item, a #tag or @mod, or use the held item.
screen.keybind_priority.guide.title: Keybind Priority guide
screen.keybind_priority.guide.0.title: One key, many bindings
screen.keybind_priority.guide.0.text:
Big modpacks put several bindings on the same key. This menu lists all of them for the key you pressed.
§fThe list order is the priority:§r the higher a binding is, the more it counts.
screen.keybind_priority.guide.1.title: Pick a mode
screen.keybind_priority.guide.1.text:
§fAll bindings:§r every binding reacts, like without this mod.
§fTop binding only:§r just the highest binding that can react right now. It is marked §6★ active§r, the rest wait as backup.
screen.keybind_priority.guide.2.title: Sort and switch off
screen.keybind_priority.guide.2.text:
§f⤒ ▲ ▼§r move a binding up or down. §fOff§r silences a binding on this key only.
Nothing is rebound: remove the mod and every key works like before.
screen.keybind_priority.guide.3.title: Item conditions
screen.keybind_priority.guide.3.text: §fItem§r makes a binding depend on what you hold. §fOnly with item:§r it reacts only with a matching item. §fPrefer item:§r it jumps to the top while you hold one, e.g. vein mine with §b#minecraft:pickaxes§r.
screen.keybind_priority.guide.4.title: Good to know
screen.keybind_priority.guide.4.caption: opens this menu for any key
screen.keybind_priority.guide.4.text:
Rules apply while you play. Inventories, chat and other menus keep the normal keybinds.
You can open this guide again any time with §f?§r at the top right.
